chapters.label: Live: the 2026 final
chapters.text: The 2026 European futsal final, in Pesaro, Italy. Alex Merlim starts for Sporting, at thirty-nine! The whistle goes. Sporting beat Palma two nil, and Merlim celebrates.

chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: Here is how he shoots from far out. The pass comes. One touch to set it, then bang! Goal!

chapters.label: Replay: one touch, then shoot
chapters.text: Again, slowly. His first touch pushes the ball forward, out of his feet. His head comes up. Then he hits it hard, with his laces.

chapters.label: Practise it
chapters.text: Now you try. Take one touch to set yourself, then shoot with confidence!
